ideas.name: any warning after an acceleration
ideas.why: the last 5 bars moved the old trend's way more than the 10 before them: a blow-off, the late buyers (sellers) arriving at once, and nothing left to push after

ideas.name: any warning soon after an opposite warning
ideas.why: a warning the other way in the last 10 bars: the box is flip-flopping, a sign of a market with no direction, where turns rotate

ideas.name: any warning against a trend running since the open
ideas.why: the 1m MACD side began within the first 15 minutes and has held since: an opening drive, the day's strongest flow, which a warning rarely turns
